claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: When acquire_and_get() observes that a cached probe result is already available, it releases the per-key lock before returning that cached value.

evidence.note: The frozen change adds key_lock.release() immediately before returning a non-null cached probe result.

claim_001.rationale: The behavior follows directly from the added lock-release statement.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was introduced to prevent waiting threads from remaining blocked after an HTTP/2 probe result had already been cached.

evidence.note: Commit title: Fix HTTP/2 probe cache lock leak.
The changelog states that waiting connection threads could remain blocked after the probe result was cached.

claim_002.rationale: Both commit and changelog explicitly describe the blocked-thread problem being fixed.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve HTTP request throughput.
claim_003.rationale: Neither the diff, commit message, nor changelog identifies throughput improvement as the primary purpose.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.rationale: The frozen change only modifies lock handling in the HTTP/2 probe cache.
